text:
Best line: smooth bump shapes refined by simulated annealing at high resolution with FFT scoring, later superseded by a hinge-penalty formulation. Old best p0013 (0.835095) came from p0004 (0.832672) via upsampling to N=3000, scipy.signal.fftconvolve instead of np.convolve, perturbation sizes as fractions of N, and coordinate sweeps every 500 iterations; p0004 came from p0001 by replacing the constant start with cos^p bumps plus simulated annealing (multiplicative, block, noise perturbations). Target is a broad flat top of f*f; p0013 had ~39% of knots within 5% of max, peak at 0.818 of support.

What worked: p0007 (0.824845) three-block staircase from two-level init — multi-level structure helps but coarse levels are insufficient. p0009 (0.831674) multi-resolution coordinate descent plus perturbations around p0007. p0012 (0.827498) K=10 contiguous-block coordinate descent on N=600 seeded from quantized p0007 — sharp piecewise structure competitive but below smooth bumps. p0011 (0.832952) central notch/two-bump search gained only +0.000281, so a central deficit barely helps. p0008 (0.805797) improved coordinate-wise hill climbing with midpoint resampling and tuned steps. p0005 (0.796296) grid-searched two-level step. p0003 (0.796973) multi-resolution bumps plus coordinate ascent. p0002 (0.763518) random hill climbing over structured bumps.

What failed: p0006 (0.790629) coordinate-wise multiplicative hill climbing on the two-level init underperformed its own start, likely because per-coordinate moves break the flat-top structure. p0010 (0.796973) analytic gradient ascent gave zero gain over p0003, so gradients are not the bottleneck. p0011's notch search collapsed to no change. Coarse three-level search (p0007) plateaus well below smooth high-resolution shapes.

Open questions: whether finer resolution than N=3000 or a better annealer schedule can push past 0.835; why p0013's convolution peak is off-centre at 0.818 and whether re-centring or asymmetric shaping helps; whether sharp many-block structure can be combined with smooth refinement rather than competing; whether the flat-top objective has a ceiling near 0.84.
